headline: SFG @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 3.83 at ARI 4.73, with a projected total of 8.56. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (SFG -0.55, ARI -0.43), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.98, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -12.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Landen Roupp has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Willy Adames, Corbin Carroll, Ildemaro Vargas, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adrian Del Castillo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
